voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

chunks.text: It's always a good thing to have a hobby, such as collecting stamps or baking.
For Miss Patty, a school bus driver, her hobby of knitting has made her really touch the community.
Miss Patty always wanted to do something in her spare time to help the students.
After a conversation with one of the students, things took a turn from knitting one hat to knitting more hats.
The boy in the school uniform gets on the bus, and he goes, 'What are you doing?'
He said, 'That would be great having such a warm hat in icy winter.'
So I said, 'What colour would you like?'
Miss Patty told the local newspaper.
Several years have passed since that day, and Miss Patty has already knitted 7,083 hats, along with some gloves for students.
Sometimes she will get the student's favourite colour before she begins the project.
What is more moving is that Miss Patty buys all the materials using her own cash.
Some people do give her gift cards around the Christmas holidays to help,
but she still withdraws a lot of dollars from her own bank account.
She also manages her time well to keep her kitchen and bedroom tidy and even to visit the local museum for inspiration.
Along with the charity act of making pretty hats for the students that will keep them warm,
Miss Patty also gets praise for being a trusted friend to the students.
Of course, the kids can buy hats from a store, but they always like hers better.
